name: MROffice
description: MR Office — the open-source editors of the AI office suite closest to Microsoft Office: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF and code in the browser. Copilot in every editor edits real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with you; an MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex create and edit them; embed it in your app with one line.

capability_evidence.memory-context: pace — ask about your files, notes and canvas and get answers that cite their sources; it drafts new documents, sheets and decks, and builds a small tool on the canvas when you need one.
capability_evidence.mcp-support: preadsheets, presentations, PDF and code in the browser, and an AI that edits real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with you.
capability_evidence.self-hosted: th 2.1 authorization server (PKCE, client ID metadata documents, dynamic registration): your app can sign people in with their MR Office account and act with the scopes they allow.
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: ository publishes the source code of its editors: the same editors MR Office runs, which you can build, run and embed on your own.

friction.note_en: Easy. install via npx one-liner; needs npm install/build; configure config file, OAuth login flow; GUI application
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 npx one-liner 安装；需要 npm install/build；需配置 config file、OAuth login flow；GUI application

analysis.summary_en: MR Office is an AI office suite for real files: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF, on the web and in a free desktop app, with an AI beside every document and live co-editing.
